items.text: Yehova anayankhula ndi Yoweli mwana wa Petueli.
Kodi zinthu zokhala ngati izi zinayamba zaonekapo mʼnthawi yanu,
ndipo ana anuwo afotokozere ana awo,
ndipo ana awo adzafotokozere mʼbado winawo.
Lirani mofuwula, inu nonse amene mumamwa vinyo;
lirani mofuwula chifukwa cha vinyo watsopano,
Mtundu wa anthu wathira nkhondo dziko langa,
ndipo wathyola mitengo yanga ya mkuyu.
chifukwa cha mwamuna wa utsikana wake.
Chopereka cha chakudya ndi cha chakumwa
lirani mofuwula inu alimi a mphesa;
imvani chisoni chifukwa cha tirigu ndi barele,
makangadza, kanjedza ndi mitengo ya apulosi,
Inu ansembe, valani ziguduli ndipo lirani;
lirani mofuwula, inu amene mumatumikira pa guwa lansembe.
inu amene mumatumikira pamaso pa Mulungu wanga;
pakuti chopereka cha chakudya ndi cha chakumwa
ku nyumba ya Yehova Mulungu wanu
lidzabwera ngati chiwonongeko chochokera kwa Wamphamvuzonse.
malawi amoto apsereza mitengo yonse ya mʼtchire.
ndipo moto wapsereza msipu wa kuthengo.

items.text: tsiku la mitambo ndi la mdima wandiweyani.
gulu lalikulu ndi la ankhondo amphamvu likubwera,
kumbuyo kwawo malawi amoto akutentha zinthu.
Patsogolo pawo dziko lili ngati munda wa Edeni,
ngati gulu lalikulu la ankhondo lokonzekera nkhondo.
Akangowaona, anthu a mitundu ina amazunzika mu mtima;
ndipo amphamvu ndi amene amamvera kulamula kwake.
bwererani kwa Ine ndi mtima wanu wonse
posala zakudya ndi kukhetsa misozi," akutero Yehova.
pakuti Iye ndi wokoma mtima ndi wachifundo,
Akudziwa ndani? Mwina adzasintha maganizo nʼkutimvera chisoni,
a chopereka cha chakudya ndi cha chakumwa
Ansembe amene amatumikira pamaso pa Yehova,
alire pakati pa guwa lansembe ndi khonde la Nyumba ya Yehova.
Azinena kuti, "Inu Yehova, achitireni chifundo anthu anu.
Musalole kuti cholowa chanu chikhale chinthu chonyozeka,
kuti anthu a mitundu ina awalamulire.
Kodi nʼchifukwa chiyani anthu a mitundu ina amanena kuti,
Pamenepo Yehova adzachitira nsanje dziko lake
"Ine ndikukutumizirani tirigu, vinyo watsopano ndi mafuta
"Ine ndidzachotsa ankhondo akumpoto kuti apite kutali ndi inu,
kuwapirikitsira ku dziko lowuma ndi lachipululu,
gulu lawo lakutsogolo ndidzalipirikitsira ku nyanja ya kummawa
ndi gulu lawo lakumbuyo, ku nyanja ya kumadzulo.
pakuti msipu wa ku chipululu ukuphukira.
mitengo ya mkuyu ndi mpesa ikubereka kwambiri.
Inu anthu a ku Ziyoni sangalalani,
mvula yoyambirira ndi mvula ya nthawi ya mphukira, monga poyamba paja.
mʼmitsuko mudzasefukira vinyo watsopano ndi mafuta.
"Ine ndidzakubwezerani zonse zimene zinawonongedwa ndi dzombe,
dzombe lopanda mapiko ndi dzombe lowuluka;
gulu langa lalikulu la nkhondo limene ndinalitumiza pakati panu.
Mudzakhala ndi chakudya chambiri, mpaka mudzakhuta,
ndipo mudzatamanda dzina la Yehova Mulungu wanu,
Pamenepo inu mudzadziwa kuti Ine ndili mu Israeli,
kuti Ine ndine Yehova Mulungu wanu,
ndidzakhuthulira Mzimu wanga pa anthu onse.
Ana anu aamuna ndi ana anu aakazi adzanenera,
Ngakhalenso pa antchito anga aamuna ndi aakazi
ndizo magazi, moto ndi utsi watolotolo.
lisanafike tsiku lalikulu ndi loopsa la Ambuye.
pakuti chipulumutso chidzakhala pa Phiri la Ziyoni

items.text: ndipo ndidzawabweretsa ku Chigwa cha Yehosafati.
chifukwa cha cholowa changa, anthu anga Aisraeli,
pakuti anabalalitsa anthu anga pakati pa mitundu ya anthu
ndipo anyamata anawasinthanitsa ndi akazi achiwerewere;

"Kodi tsopano inu a ku Turo ndi Sidoni ndi madera onse a Filisitiya, muli ndi chiyani chotsutsana nane? Kodi mukundibwezera pa zinthu zimene ndakuchitirani? Ngati inu mukundibwezera, Ine ndidzabwezera zochita zanu mofulumira ndi mwachangu pa mitu yanu.
Pakuti munatenga siliva ndi golide wanga ndi kupita nacho chuma changa chamtengowapatali ku nyumba zanu zopembedzera mafano.
Inu munagulitsa anthu a ku Yuda ndi Yerusalemu kwa Agriki, kuti apite kutali ndi malire a dziko lawo.
"Taonani, Ine ndidzawachotsa kumalo kumene munawagulitsako, ndipo ndidzabwezera zimene mwachita pa mitu yanu.
Ndidzagulitsa ana anu aamuna ndi ana anu aakazi kwa anthu a ku Yuda, ndipo iwo adzawagulitsa kwa Aseba, mtundu wa anthu okhala kutali." Yehova wayankhula.
Lengezani izi pakati pa anthu a mitundu ina:
Asilikali onse afike pafupi ndipo ayambe nkhondo.
Sulani makasu anu kuti akhale malupanga
Bwerani msanga, inu anthu a mitundu yonse kuchokera ku mbali zonse,
ndikuweruza anthu a mitundu yonse yozungulira.
Chigulu cha anthu, chigulu cha anthu,
ndipo mawu ake adzamveka ngati bingu kuchokera mu Yerusalemu;
Koma Yehova adzakhala pothawira pa anthu ake,
linga la anthu a ku Israeli.
"Pamenepo inu mudzadziwa kuti Ine Yehova Mulungu wanu,
ndimakhala mu Ziyoni, phiri langa lopatulika.
mitsinje yonse ya ku Yuda idzadzaza ndi madzi.
chifukwa cha nkhondo imene anathira anthu a ku Yuda
mʼdziko limene anakhetsa magazi a anthu osalakwa.
Koma Yuda adzakhala ndi anthu mpaka muyaya
Kukhetsa magazi kwawo kumene Ine sindinakhululuke
